# Revenue recognition logic:
# - Nothing is recognized before the invoice month.
# - In the invoice month, recognize all billable days from billing start through the

# - After the invoice month, recognize only the overlap between the billing period and each month.

def as_date(v):
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.date()
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return v
    return None

def revenue_for_cell(row_num, col_num):
    amount = ws_vals.cell(row_num, 7).value      # G
    inv = as_date(ws_vals.cell(row_num, 4).value) # D
    start = as_date(ws_vals.cell(row_num, 8).value) # H
    end = as_date(ws_vals.cell(row_num, 9).value)   # I
    m_start = as_date(ws_vals.cell(2, col_num).value)
    m_end = as_date(ws_vals.cell(3, col_num).value)

    if amount is None or inv is None or start is None or end is None or m_start is None or m_end is None:
        return ""
    inv_month_end = date(inv.year, inv.month, 1)
    # calculate EOMONTH(inv,0)
    if inv.month == 12:
        inv_month_end = date(inv.year, 12, 31)
    else:
        inv_month_end = date(inv.year, inv.month + 1, 1) - datetime.resolution

    # datetime.resolution gives microsecond delta; normalize date if needed
    if isinstance(inv_month_end, datetime):
        inv_month_end = inv_month_end.date()

    # Simpler robust month-end calculation
    if inv.month == 12:
        inv_month_end = date(inv.year, 12, 31)
    else:
        inv_month_end = date(inv.year, inv.month + 1, 1)
        inv_month_end = date.fromordinal(inv_month_end.toordinal() - 1)

    if m_end < inv_month_end:
        return ""
    total_days = (end - start).days + 1
    if total_days <= 0:
        return ""

    if m_start.year == inv.year and m_start.month == inv.month:
        days = max(0, (min(end, m_end) - start).days + 1)
        return amount * days / total_days

    if m_start > end or m_end < start:
        return ""

    days = (min(end, m_end) - max(start, m_start)).days + 1
    return amount * days / total_days
